findings.title: Global catalog generation append is not serialized across case IDs
findings.evidence: §42 defines a single monotonic-generation append-only catalog; locks mentioned are per-case lifecycle or sidecar locks. The SDD does not serialize generation allocation, full record append, and Sync across concurrent case create/cleanup operations. Tests cover interleaved sidecar appends but not concurrent catalog transitions.
findings.required_change: Define a catalog-wide append lock/atomic generation allocator over generation read, complete frame append, and Flush+Sync; test concurrent transitions for two different cases followed by restart and contiguous-chain/state verification.
